verdict.rationale: Restate documents a public HTTP API for invoking handlers on the Restate Server, plus typed SDK clients. It also documents an Admin API (cluster state, per-service OpenAPI 3.1 definitions) and an Introspection SQL API, so the product can be driven and inspected programmatically. The 404 probe only shows no OpenAPI file is hosted on the docs domain; it does not contradict the documented admin endpoints. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Restate via its API, and fuller evidence of the Admin API's management coverage (services, deployments, invocations) beyond the endpoint titles shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To call a function over HTTP, send a request to the Restate Server, specifying the service and the function you want to invoke.
There are three ways to invoke a handler: over HTTP, using typed clients, or through Kafka topics.
Restate exposes information on invocations and application state via its CLI and Introspection SQL API.
Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the service, describing all handlers and their request/response schemas.
